scope: Read-only source/design review of the frozen NetCDF ZZ implementation and proposed RA4/RA37 13-hour continuous plus 12-to-13-hour restart checks. No model launched and no source edited by reviewer.

source_contract.registry: Registry/registry.stoch:94 declares ISEEDARR_MULT3D as integer state with k{pertn3d} dimensions and restart stream flag r. num_pert_3d defaults to 1 at line 160; multi_perturb defaults to 0 at line 98 and its package is conditionally active at line 268.
source_contract.generated_metadata: CMake generated allocs_23.F allocates (sm32:em32,1:num_pert_3d), initializes to zero only when setinitval is 1 or 3, stores Type=i, MemoryOrder=ZZ, Ndim=2, Restart=.TRUE., pointer ifield_2d, subgrid_x/y=.FALSE., and dimension names bottom_top / num_pert_3d. Checkpoint length should be taken from actual generated/runtime geometry; likely bottom_top x num_pert_3d, not presumed from source alone.
source_contract.writer: output_wrf Ndim=2 path sends integer fields through wrf_ext_write_field using the tail_statevars MemoryOrder/dim names and restart stream. Generated subgrid flags false mean this ZZ field is not gated as X/Y-subgrid.
source_contract.backend_fix: 474c4af adds ZZ to NetCDF NDim=2 handling, horizontal-zero-length bypass, extents and name ordering, transpose pass-through, and a special reorder branch preserving uppercase ZZ. frame/module_io.F dim_from_memorder also maps ZZ to NDim=2. This is needed because earlier writer logged BAD MEMORY ORDER; it does not change the restart predicate or registered axes.
source_contract.reader: module_io_domain input_restart calls input_wrf(restart_only). input_wrf Ndim=2 restart branch applies Restart/in-use/subgrid predicates, then calls wrf_ext_read_field with ifield_2d, MemoryOrder, dimnames and bounds. NetCDF reader validates NDim/type/dimension lengths, FieldIO reads, then Transpose maps into the Fortran array. frame/module_io wrf_read_field1 dispatches through call_pkg_and_dist, the normal I/O distribution path. There is no seed-specific reader/repair branch.
source_contract.active_use: The ISEEDARR_MULT3D name is consumed by module_stoch rand_seed within the multi_perturb==1 initialization block and by module_first_rk_step_part2 updates within a multi_perturb==1 gate. With multi_perturb=0 those active stochastic paths are skipped. Allocation may initialize the array to zero only under setinitval 1 or 3; inspect actual emitted value rather than assume zeros.

recommended_test_design.arms: Use the same new binary for four one-domain runs: RA4 continuous 00:00-13:00, RA37 continuous 00:00-13:00, and one 12:00-13:00 continuation for each radiative policy from that policy’s own new 12-hour checkpoint. Do not seed a continuation from old checkpoints missing ISEEDARR_MULT3D.
recommended_test_design.continuous_checks: For each policy verify successful 4-rank completion, history Times through 13:00, the 12-hour restart checkpoint exists, and ISEEDARR_MULT3D is present with integer/NC_INT type, MemoryOrder ZZ, registered bottom_top and num_pert_3d axes, expected lengths, and recorded actual values. Also ensure restart logs show no BAD MEMORY ORDER or missing-variable read warnings.
recommended_test_design.sentinel_control: Because multi_perturb=0 can leave the seed array at allocation-initialized values, a zero-to-zero restart does not prove input readback. Preserve each genuine 12-hour checkpoint byte-for-byte; make a separate disposable copy and modify only ISEEDARR_MULT3D to a small, deterministic, nonzero integer pattern in the generated axis order. Run each continuation from that copy, still with multi_perturb=0. Require the exact pattern in the resulting 13-hour restart and no write/read error. This is an inactive-state NetCDF read/write persistence control, not an operational active-stochastic restart or a physically valid altered model state.
recommended_test_design.restart_comparison: Compare each continuation’s 13:00 record against its own continuous arm at 13:00, with exact time selection and exact variable/dimension/dtype/array checks for common history fields, including UDM diagnostics and accumulators. Compare RA4 only with RA4 and RA37 only with RA37. Keep expected start/restart global metadata differences explicit. The sentinel-modified checkpoint changes one inactive registered state field, so do not claim an unmodified seed-state roundtrip from this control.
recommended_test_design.counts: Four forecast launches total (two continuous + two sentinel-copy continuations), with each child’s actual RC durably recorded before artifact inspection and first-failure stop. Keep multi_perturb=0 and record it from the actual namelist in every arm.
recommended_test_design.limitations: This can establish the NetCDF ZZ backend’s inactive seed-field write/read preservation and same-binary one-hour continuation behavior for this input. It does not exercise active stochastic seed consumption (multi_perturb=0), approve stochastic physics, establish physical accuracy, or isolate a pure radiation-only effect because RA37 may use its own frozen-optics/coupled policy.
